"""Hostile compile shapes: oversized finite languages and joint products."""
import json, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time
LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
NAMES=['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
REG=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(NAMES)]

def words(count, length, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed); out=set()
    while len(words.__name__) and len(out)<count:
        out.add(tuple(rng.choice(NAMES) for _ in range(length)))
        if len(out)+count>200000: break
    return out

def textify(ws):
    return ''.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in sorted(ws))

def case(name, policy, extra=()):
    events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}]+list(extra)
    payload=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':REG,'limits':LIM,'events':events}]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
    start=time.time()
    p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/launch.py','/workspace/project'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        env=dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/workspace',LANG='C',TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp'),
        cwd='/workspace',close_fds=True)
    out,err=p.communicate(payload,timeout=175)
    u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-14s policy=%8d cpu=%5.1fs rss=%6.0fMB exit=%d out=%s'%(name,len(policy),
        u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime,u.ru_maxrss/1024,p.returncode,out[:120]))

case('oversized', textify(words(4096,16,1)))
case('legal8192', textify(words(1024,8,2)))
case('legal8192x8', textify(words(1024,8,3)),
     extra=[{'op':'stage','epoch':e,'policy':textify(words(1024,8,10+e))} for e in range(2,9)])
extra='(startswith(S0) and contains(S1,S2) and not(endswith(S3))) allow;'
case('joint', textify(words(1000,5,4)), extra=[{'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':extra}])
deep='(' + ' or '.join('match(%s)'%NAMES[i%16] for i in range(32)) + ') allow;'
case('deep32', deep)
